summary: This class analyzes Gemara sugyot in Masekhet Bava Batra regarding communal responsibilities and tax obligations. It explores whether Hakhamim and Torah scholars are exempt from paying security taxes for city gates, head taxes to the monarchy, and other municipal levies. The discussion reviews biblical derashot and interpretations from Rishonim concerning who qualifies for exemptions and whether orphans can be taxed to dig a new well.
subjects: Communal tax obligations and city gate security
Definition of Toratan Umanutan according to Rishonim
Derashot from Tehillim, Shir HaShirim, Hoshia, and Ezra
Exemptions of Minda, Bilo, and Vahalach
Levying taxes on orphans for city wells
questions: Are Torah scholars exempt from paying for city gates and security?
How do Rishonim define who qualifies as a Hakham for tax exemptions?
What scriptural sources are brought to exempt Hakhamim from monarchical head taxes?
Which specific taxes mentioned in Sefer Ezra apply to communal exemptions?
May a community collect funds from orphans to pay for digging a new well?
